name: MetrAIyux 0S Operator Command Registry
purpose: Allowlisted local operator commands that the 0S command runner can execute from the repo workspace.
safety_model: Commands run only from the local repo operator environment.
Public browser surfaces can describe the existence of the operator sync lane, but should not publish the command allowlist.
Only IDs in this registry are executable by tools/0s-command-runner.mjs.
Secrets, destructive commands, and production publishing are intentionally excluded unless a future approval gate is added.

commands.title: Sync Obsidian Vault Into Local Brain
commands.when_to_run: After editing curated notes in obsidian-vault that have brain: true frontmatter.

commands.title: Inspect Obsidian Brain Export
commands.when_to_run: After syncing the vault to confirm how many notes and chunks entered the local brain.
commands.result: Prints note count, chunk count, and generation timestamp.

commands.title: Generate Obsidian Neural Map
commands.when_to_run: After adding, linking, retagging, or reorganizing Obsidian notes.
commands.result: Writes obsidian-vault/_neural-map/graph-data.js for the private neural map page.

commands.title: Generate Public Neural Map
commands.when_to_run: After syncing curated Obsidian notes and before deploying the public web neural map.

commands.title: Validate Brain Scripts And JSON
commands.command: node --check metraiyux_0s_site/brain/local-brain.js && node --check tools/sync-obsidian-brain.mjs && node --check tools/generate-obsidian-neural-map.mjs && node --check tools/generate-public-neural-map.mjs && node --check metraiyux_0s_site/assets/public-neural-map.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('metraiyux_0s_site/brain/obsidian-sync.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('ops/0s-command-registry.json','utf8')); console.log('brain files ok')"
commands.when_to_run: After changing the local brain loader, Obsidian sync script, command registry, or exported brain data.
commands.result: Confirms JavaScript syntax and JSON parsing.

commands.title: Serve MetrAIyux 0S Site Locally
commands.when_to_run: When testing local-brain.html or operator pages in a browser.
commands.result: Starts a local static server at http://127.0.0.1:4173/.

commands.title: Run Static SkyeCrawler QA
commands.when_to_run: After content, navigation, vault-brain export, or static site changes.
commands.result: Runs static crawler QA using the configured local site target.

commands.title: Run Repo Health Check
commands.when_to_run: Before packaging, handoff, or repo backup.
commands.result: Runs the repo health check script.
